description: Search and page through identity-provider groups synchronized to Portkey over SCIM. Use this to resolve a group ID or exact display name before create_scim_workspace_mapping; it reads directory groups only and does not show their workspace mappings or individual members. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.

page.description: Zero-based results page to retrieve; the first page is 0. These SCIM tools name the parameter page, not the current_page used by other list tools.

page_size.description: SCIM groups per page, from 1 through 100

search.description: Case-insensitive text to match against SCIM group names

name: list_scim_groups

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
